mapping_scheme_readonly_tip: The mixing assumption comes from the loaded configuration file and cannot be changed here. Internal and external mixing use different composition tables - load the matching configuration file.
mixing_scheme_readonly_tip: Chooses the mixing assumption for a single run; the comparison always runs both arms. The initial value is inferred from the number of composition columns in the loaded file and can be changed manually; the preview then shows the configuration actually sent to the model.
about_text: Standalone internal/external mixing comparison GUI for SCRAM.
about_text_full: SCRAM BoxApp is a workflow-oriented scientific desktop app for comparing internal and external mixing assumptions and their effects on aerosol size, composition, and mixing state. It provides bilingual UI, structured table editing, live runtime monitoring, summary-driven results browsing, and Chinese PDF report export.
experiment_name_hint: Results live in one case directory per experiment (<results root>/<experiment name>; the template id by default). Re-running the same name moves the previous result to <results root>/history/<experiment name>_<timestamp>/ (the latest 3 are kept); the case directory always holds the newest run.
custom_config_desc: Custom configuration loaded from an external .cfg file. Parameters may differ from built-in presets — review all tabs before running.
nearest_note: External mixing resolves particles in size-composition cells and can distinguish mixed and unmixed particles within the same size section.
legacy_note: Internal mixing assumes one average composition per size section; it is faster but does not resolve composition diversity among particles.
sulfate_computation_tip: How sulfate is treated: 0 = handled by bulk equilibrium (default); 1 = explicit dynamic solve. Only 0 and 1 are accepted; any other value is treated as 0.
redistribution_method_tip: 0 or 1 = no size redistribution; every value of 2 or more uses the same redistribution algorithm (2-6 give identical results). Only when the item above is switched to the legacy algorithm do 2-6 regain their old meanings (legacy + 6 loses number conservation - not recommended).
redistribution_option_tip: Algorithm used for size redistribution: default = moving-centre method (recommended); legacy = old algorithm, only for reproducing older results.
nucl_model_tip: 1 = sulfate-ammonia-water ternary nucleation; 5 = paper validation mode (uses the built-in hazy distribution and a constant sulfate source, ignores the initial values in the configuration, and locks the layout to 30 species). With any other value, nucleation never happens even if the switch is on.
dynamic_solver_tip: Time integration method: 0 = euler / 1 = ETR / 2 = ROS2. Only these three values are accepted; any other value calls no solver at all and the run hangs (now blocked before starting).
kind_grid_tip: 0 = generate logarithmically spaced size bounds automatically (the Size bins table is ignored); 1 = use the bounds typed in the Size bins table (factory default).
cut_dim_tip: Size sections below this diameter get an extra inorganic equilibrium solve after each step; sections above it only follow the dynamic solver. Leaving it at 0 (factory default) means no such equilibrium; raising it above the smallest size bound opens a path the factory configurations never exercised, so results will change.
init_scenario_tip: Effective only when the initial-value source is set to the built-in scenario distributions: it selects the hazy / urban / clean distribution used to generate the initial state.
structure_help: Set species count, size bins and fraction sections, then click 「Generate Structure」 to create empty tables. After editing table values, click 「Rebuild Tables」 to sync changes to the config preview. Note: 「Generate Structure」 clears and recreates all tables — edited data will be lost.
runtime_missing: No ProgramSCRAM compatible with the current platform was found. On Linux, provide a native ELF build or set SCRAM_PROGRAMSCRAM to the executable path.
cannot_remove_species: At least one species must remain.
nucl_model_layout_locked_tip: Paper validation mode uses a fixed 30-species layout (species 2 = black carbon, species 4 = sulfate), so the species count is locked. Switch the nucleation model back to ternary nucleation to edit the layout.
dtmin_seconds_dead_tip: This field has no effect at present: the model reads the minimum time step but the current version does not use it to limit the step size. It is kept only for configuration-file compatibility.
tag_init_tip: Where initial values come from: 1 = the per-bin masses written in the configuration (default); 0 = generated from the built-in scenario distributions (only then does the Environment state selector matter; the per-bin mass table is ignored). The paper validation mode makes this item ineffective.
tag_init_mass_table_locked_tip: Initial values currently come from the built-in scenario distributions, so the model does not use this table and it is locked. Switch back to per-bin masses from the configuration to edit it; the values actually generated by the scenario are in csv/mass_init.txt of the run, viewable on the results page.
load_config_invalid_prefix: The configuration was loaded, but it has the following problems; the run will be blocked (fix them in the structure editor, or start from a factory template):
structure_reset_frac: Changing fraction sections from {old} to {new} resets the fraction bounds to a uniform grid; hand-edited bounds will be lost (check the preview for the config actually sent to the core). Continue?
structure_reset_sizebin: Changing size bins from {old} to {new} resets the diameter bounds to a logarithmic grid; hand-edited bounds will be lost (check the preview for the config actually sent to the core). Continue?
structure_reset_mixing_note: Note: crossing one composition column changes how mixing is represented (1 column = internal, several = external); after saving and reloading, the mixing assumption selector is inferred accordingly.
init_scenario_inert_tip: Initial values currently come from the per-bin masses in the configuration, so the model does not use scenario distributions and this selector is disabled. Switch the initial-value source to the built-in scenario distributions to enable it.
